name: EPIC 201905098
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 9.9 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201905098 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.913831 (16th-84th percentiles 9.020232-10.292249), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201905098: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5349.703 +/- 181 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201905098 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4312.734375 (16th-84th percentiles 4155.703125-4466.25), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.49 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,313 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.17 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,350 K at its surface.
